# Whale intelligence — historical test fixtures (Phase 7)

**All values are synthetic**, designed by hand so every expected result can be computed on paper.
They are generated by `tests/whale_fakes.py` (formulas below) and served in the providers'
documented response shapes to the real adapters. They are not market data.

Shapes: Coin Metrics `GET /v4/timeseries/asset-metrics` (verified against real responses for BTC and
ETH on 2026-09-24); Blockchair `/{chain}/addresses`, `/bitcoin/outputs`, `/bitcoin/blocks`,
`/ethereum/transactions` with `?q=`, `?s=`, `?a=` (documented format, API v2 — no live response
could be captured from the development environment).

Addresses: the Binance (`34xp4v…`) and UK government (`bc1q7ydr…`) addresses (also in the shipped
BitInfoCharts seed file) are labelled by a small test label file published 2026-09-08 05:29 UTC
(source "Test labels"; the real seed was published 2026-09-24, after this synthetic history); the ten "unknown" addresses are valid Base58Check addresses built
from a counter (owned by nobody known); Ethereum addresses are synthetic hex.

## Daily data (UTC days 2026-04-17 … 2026-09-09; "last week" = 2026-09-03 … 2026-09-09, k = 1 … 7)

| Series | BTC | ETH |
|---|---|---|
| Exchange inflow | 20,000 every day | 200,000 every day |
| Exchange outflow | 20,000; last week 21,000 | 200,000; last week 190,000 |
| Exchange supply | 2,800,000; last week 2,800,000 − 1,000 k | 15,000,000; last week 15,000,000 + 10,000 k |
| Supply / issuance | 20,000,000 + 450 per day / 450 | 122,000,000 / 2,700 |
| Status (Coin Metrics) | `flash` for the last 3 days, `reviewed` before; status time = next day 02:00 UTC | same |
| Coins ≥ 1 y moved | 1,000; last week 1,500 | — |
| Coins ≥ 155 d moved / coinbase-origin moved / CDD | 3,000 / 450 / 5,000,000 | — |

## Expected results — as of NOW = 2026-09-10 12:00 UTC (knowledge time = NOW)

NOW lies in the past on purpose: the API never looks beyond the real current time.
Exchange window ends 2026-09-09 (last day due: day end + 12 h).

| Component | Computation | Value | Sub-score |
|---|---|---|---|
| BTC net flow 7 d | (140,000 − 147,000) ÷ 2,793,000 × 100 | −0.2506 % | +0.2506 |
| BTC exchange supply 30 d | (2,793,000 − 2,800,000) ÷ 2,800,000 × 100 | −0.2500 % | +0.0833 |
| BTC unknown large holders 7 d | (101,000 − 100,000) ÷ 100,000 × 100 | +1.0000 % | +1.0000 |
| BTC coins ≥ 1 y, 7 d vs 90 d | 1,500 ÷ 1,000 | 1.5000 | −0.5000 |

- **BTC score** = 100 × (0.35 × 0.2506 + 0.15 × 0.0833 + 0.25 × 1 + 0.25 × −0.5) = **22.5**
  ("accumulation").
- **ETH**: net flow 70,000 ÷ 15,070,000 = +0.4645 % → −0.4645; supply +0.4667 % → −0.1556;
  no snapshots, no coin-age data → weight 0.50 (exactly the minimum) → score = 100 ×
  (0.35 × −0.4645 + 0.15 × −0.1556) ÷ 0.50 = **−37.2** ("distribution").
- Miner spending (BTC): 3,150 ÷ 3,150 = **1.0000**.
- Contradictions (BTC): exchange flows (+0.2506, accumulation) vs old coins (−0.5,
  distribution) → **contradiction**; exchange flows vs large holders (+1.0) → **consistent**;
  whales vs ETF → **insufficient data** (no ETF data loaded); labelled Binance −2 % vs Coin Metrics
  −0.25 % (09-02 → 09-09) → **no clear direction** (0.25 % is below the ±0.5 % threshold).

## Point in time — as of 2026-09-06 12:00 UTC (knowledge time = NOW)

Visible: Coin Metrics days ≤ 09-05 (status time 02:00 next day), Blockchair days ≤ 09-05, only the
09-03 snapshot, **no labels** (published 2026-09-08 05:29).

- Net flow: −3,000 ÷ 2,797,000 = −0.1073 % → +0.1073; supply 30 d: −0.1071 % → +0.0357;
  holders: unavailable (no snapshot a week earlier); coins ≥ 1 y: (4 × 1,000 + 3 × 1,500) ÷ 7 ÷
  1,000 = 1.2143 → −0.2143.
- Score = 100 × (0.35 × 0.1073 + 0.15 × 0.0357 + 0.25 × −0.2143) ÷ 0.75 = **−1.4** ("neutral").
- The Binance address in the 09-03 snapshot is an **unknown large holder** in this view: its label
  was not public yet.
